Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and trimming the SELL signals before they turn into bigger losses.
plays: Trim SMH: It's a TRIM signal and currently down -12.57%. Consider reducing exposure.
Consider CRWD: It's a SELL signal with a solid gain (33.46%). Taking some profit here could de-risk.
